initial_prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished ACE OF SPADES for Chinese-themed Design 2.
Reference1 is the approved court card, authoritative for exact full-card 5:7 canvas, frame geometry, ivory margins, index cartouches and sumptuous detailed print-illustration style. Reference2 is the existing SPADE PIP ASSET: faithfully use this distinctive design as the large central emblem, retaining its recognizable silhouette, gold beaded outline, teal curled lotus leaves, red/ivory lotus rosette and turquoise jewel. Do not redesign the pip into a different decorative vocabulary.
Replace reference1's figure completely with an open warm IVORY central area inside the same scalloped gold-outlined reserve. Remove every person, head, hand, robe, crown, weapon, belt and diagonal sash. Keep the outermost BLACK band with gold/ivory lotus vines, and dense BLACK fields of teal foliage, red/ivory lotus flowers, small cream flowers and red berries surrounding the ivory reserve. Fine pale-gold cloud and lotus tracery hugs only the reserve's edges; central space is uncluttered.
Place exactly ONE very large UPRIGHT ornate BLACK SPADE from reference2 in the ivory center, centered horizontally, with its turquoise jewel close to the exact canvas center. It should occupy most of the available central ivory width, roughly 60% of total card width and 55% of height, faithfully maintaining the pip's natural proportions. Keep a clear elegant ivory gap around all its edges, including pointed top and flared stem. Preserve rich black ground visible between internal botanical elements. This is ONE upright suit emblem with bilateral ornament, NOT a double-headed spade and NOT two inverted pips. No separate center jewel outside the spade.
Indices: large BLACK serif 'A' above small solid BLACK SPADE in the upper-left ivory cartouche, same size/weight as reference1's K. Identical A/spade index rotated 180 degrees in lower-right. Exactly two A letters; no K, Q, J, Joker, other text, maker mark, tax stamp or ribbon. Overall frame and indices arranged double-ended, but single central spade remains upright as in a standard ace. One full flat portrait PNG EXACTLY 1060x1484 pixels (5:7), no mockup, cropping, perspective, watermark or signature.
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Final ACE OF SPADES for Design 2. Reference1 KING supplies ONLY the exact 5:7 canvas aspect and border geometry. Reference2 ACE supplies ALL artwork. Recompose the ace onto the same 1060x1484 portrait canvas as reference1. Keep its single ornate upright spade, turquoise jewel at canvas center, large ivory scalloped reserve with pale-gold floral edge tracery, dense black lotus corner fields, thin black outer lotus-vine band, black A/spade indices in opposing ivory cartouches. Retain the ace's composition, full ivory paper edge and meticulous details. NO people or court elements from reference1. Do not stretch the spade; slightly expand the ivory reserve sideways to accommodate the correct 5:7 shape. Keep the same moderate thin margin and corner panel positions as reference1. This is ONLY a canvas proportion correction. Deliver ONE flat full-card PNG EXACTLY 1060 pixels WIDE and 1484 pixels HIGH, aspect ratio 5:7. Not 1042x1510. No extra text or design changes.
